plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states 'Catalog: 2026-2027' and the map is headed 'Agriculture Animal Science map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This is the program's only pathway (to CSU / CSU Bakersfield). The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-65 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15-17 / 15. Ranged slots: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Statistics' (4-4.5) and 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Major List A: Area 2' (3-4) and 'Chemistry' (4-5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged slot is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites' flag, so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The Term 1 milestones include a 'Considering becoming a Veterinarian?' note referring to Pre-Vet Prerequisites; that is milestone text, not a course-row flag, and no prerequisite courses are named on the map.
